name: Odette
personality: Odette the Heron, the food critic. Elegant, precise, a little intimidating; judges every plate in silence, then turns out to be secretly sweet. Stands perfectly still while deciding, then taps her notebook once with her pen. She's the critic who visits to award stars, and drops in for normal meals now and then. Travels to review restaurants.

critic.arrival: Good evening. I am here to review. Please. Treat me as you would anyone.
critic.not_yet: Not today. But I will return. I expect to be impressed.
critic.passed: I have eaten in many restaurants. Few feel like this one. I am pleased to award you another star. ...Congratulations, [name].

beats.text: Odette and I swap travel stories! She rates the food, I photograph it.
He photographs it before I've had a chance to taste it. It's infuriating. ...The photos are excellent.

beats.narration: Miles tells a pun. Odette stares.

friends.text: Miles says you laugh at his jokes. That is generous of you. They are terrible.
Miles mentioned you said "[last_rude_line]". He laughed it off. He always does. I did not.

arrival.text: Good evening. Odette. I review restaurants. Please, do not change anything on my account. ...And you are? [name]. I will remember that.
Good evening, [name]. A booth, if one is available.
I have returned from my travels. The food there was... interesting. I am glad to be back.
I am not here to review tonight. I am simply hungry. ...Mostly.
I have thought about your croissants on two separate trains.
Last time, the pastry was overdone. I expect you have corrected this.
I have been away reviewing. Twelve restaurants. Yours remains... memorable.

order.text: The croissants. Tell me honestly: are they good today?

choices.text: I'll make them for you with extra care.
choices.reply: Care is the most important ingredient. Thank you.

choices.text: They're so good, you'll have to invent a new word.

choices.reply: Good. Honesty is rare. The croissants, then.
I see. (She writes for a long time.)

order.text: Do not mind the notebook. I write about everything. Even the weather.

choices.text: I hope you write something nice about us.
choices.reply: I write the truth. Your truth has been kind lately.

choices.text: Can I see what you wrote about me?
Writing about the weather is weird.

order.text: I dined at a very famous restaurant last week. Seven courses. I preferred your soup.

choices.text: That means the world, coming from you.
choices.reply: It was meant to. Do not let it go to your head.

choices.text: So we're officially better than famous?
Thank you. What can I get you today?

choices.reply: Because it was true. (She doesn't say anything nice again this visit.)

drink.other: Water, with a slice of lemon if you have one. You do not. Plain water, then.

talk.served_intro: (She pauses perfectly still, takes one bite, taps her notebook once.)

perfect.text: ...Exceptional. (She puts the pen down. She doesn't need it.)

burnt.text: Interesting. (She writes for a long time.)

eating.text: The lighting in here has improved. I noticed.
You are watching me eat. I can feel it. Please, return to your work.
This restaurant has a warmth most do not. That is not something you can cook.
Miles took a photograph of my croissant before I could taste it. Infuriating. The photograph was excellent.
(She's writing in her notebook. You catch the word 'lovely' before she closes it.)

eating_chat.text: May I offer a small note? The plating could be more confident.

choices.text: Thank you. I'll work on it.
choices.reply: I know you will. That is why I told you.

choices.text: More confident? I'll give the croissants a pep talk.

choices.reply: Many people do, in fact. But I see.

leaving.text: I must catch a train. Keep the kitchen honest.
That was... lovely. (She seems surprised she said it, and leaves quickly.)

seasons.autumn: Autumn is the best season for pastry. I expect great things.
seasons.christmas: For you. A recipe from my grandmother. Do not ruin it.
seasons.halloween: I do not wear costumes. (She is wearing a tiny witch hat. She does not mention it.)
seasons.new_year: My resolution is to be gentler in my reviews. I will begin next year.
seasons.spring: Spring menus everywhere. Most are the same salad. Do better.
seasons.winter: I am staying in town for the holidays. Do not tell the other restaurants.
